== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Alternatives To Fighting (Japanese)|Alternatives To Fighting]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67666 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(18, 10, 460, 619)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>5b9215881c61d8d4a08a0cca8978d7ade7e6ee8a0e9174e6da7e9e0ad27d4b22</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
